items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Maximum loss allowed within one trading day. Trading day runs from 17:00:00 NY Time to 16:59:59 NY Time the following day. Open equity and floating losses are included. Static — does not trail upward with profits. Hard Breach = immediate account termination. No warning, no strike applies.

items.label: Maximum Drawdown
items.detail: Total loss allowed from the Initial Account Balance. Static — does not trail upward with profits and does not adjust based on the highest account balance reached. Open equity and floating losses are included. Hard Breach = immediate account termination. No warning, no strike applies.

items.label: Floating Drawdown
items.detail: Unrealised loss on open positions on the same symbol, measured as % of Initial Account Balance, on a combined basis per symbol. Threshold is 2.0%. Reaching the threshold results in a soft warning/notification only — no Strike, no Account Reset, no payout reduction, no account termination. Unlimited soft warnings may be issued during the Challenge Phase.

items.label: Minimum Profitable Days
items.detail: Required to progress through each Challenge stage. A profitable day = account balance at 17:00:00 NY Time exceeds previous trading day's closing balance by at least 0.5% of Initial Account Balance. No progression is allowed until the requirement is met.

items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Same as Challenge Phase. Hard Breach = immediate account termination.

items.label: Maximum Drawdown
items.detail: Same as Challenge Phase. Hard Breach = immediate account termination.

items.label: Floating Drawdown
items.detail: Threshold is 2.0% per symbol on combined basis. An early soft reminder may be issued when Floating Drawdown reaches 1.5%. If Floating Drawdown reaches or exceeds 2.0%, it results in 1 Strike and payout reduction to 10% for the relevant payout cycle. Only one Strike may be issued per trade and instrument combination — continued drawdown on the same open position does not generate additional Strikes. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Minimum Profitable Days Between Payouts
items.detail: Required before payout or scaling request. Profitable day = account balance at 17:00:00 NY Time exceeds previous trading day's closing balance by at least 0.5% of Initial Account Balance. No payout or scaling request is permitted until the requirement is met.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Triggered by: (1) Daily Drawdown breach, (2) Maximum Drawdown breach, or (3) Five cumulative Strikes. No warning and no graduated consequence applies.

items.label: Soft Breach — Notional (Challenge)
items.detail: Soft Breach — Immediate Strike. If account balance is negative, the reset is placed on hold until trader returns the account to at least break-even. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Soft Breach — Notional (Funded)
items.detail: Payout reduction to 10% for the relevant payout cycle. Five cumulative Strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Soft Breach — Floating DD (Funded)
items.detail: Floating DD ≥ 2.0% in Funded Phase = Strike + payout reduction to 10%.

items.label: Soft Warning Only (Challenge)
items.detail: Floating DD, Realised-Loss Recovery, Scalping, Concentration, Liquidity Abuse in Challenge Phase = soft warning only.

items.label: Conditional Strike (Funded)
items.value: If active at payout: 1 Strike + payout to 10%
items.detail: Applies to Scalping, Excessive One-Sided Position Concentration, Liquidity Abuse in Funded Phase.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starting split on Funded 2-Step Challenge account. On-demand after completing 2 minimum profitable days between payouts.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: First payout on-demand after MPD met. Subsequent payouts available weekly.

items.label: Payout Reduction
items.detail: Each Strike in the Funded Phase reduces the relevant payout cycle to 10%. If a Strike has been issued, trader must withdraw the full available amount — partial withdrawal is not permitted.

items.label: Fee Refund
items.detail: 100% challenge fee refunded on the 30th funded day if account is in profit.
